sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search?q=Bobcat%20Lake (238258 'Bobcat Lake Campground', information only, reservable false)

values.note: Single site $22 a night. Day use/boat launch $5 per vehicle a day or $30 a season, not charged to campers. Fees are for the summer full-service period; in early spring and late fall, with no services, fees at some areas are not charged.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/bobcat-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night', 'Day use/boat launch - $5/vehicle/day or $30/vehicle/season', 'Day use fees will not be charged to those who have already paid for a campground campsite', 'Fees shown are for the summer recreation period when full services are provided...'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No reservations. Claim a site in person; on site you may be able to pay with the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay (download it first: cell service is limited). Campers must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/bobcat-lake-campground ('No reservations - first come, first serve', 'not longer than 14 days', 'Campers must occupy the site the first night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10192012 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One loop of drive-in sites with privacy screening, each with a tent pad, table, fire ring, lantern post and gravel parking spur; one accessible site. (A second description on the same FS page says 12 sites; 'No. of Sites: 11'.) No length limit posted. Eight people, two motor vehicles and at most one RV or camper trailer per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/bobcat-lake-campground ('Bobcat Lake campground features one loop with 11 campsites', 'No. of Sites: 11', 'No. of Accessible sites: 1', 'gravel parking spur', 'a maximum of one RV or camper trailer'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two accessible vault toilets; hand pump near site 3. Boat ramp adjacent to the campground; day-use picnic area with toilets, grills and a changing house on the Bobcat Lake shore half a mile east.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/bobcat-lake-campground ('Two accessible vault toilets are located in the campground and water is provided by a centrally located hand pump', 'Drinking water: Hand pump near site #3 and in day use area', 'There is a boat ramp adjacent to the campground'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Opens with full services the Friday before Memorial Day (subject to change). 2026: reduced services from October 15 (no water or garbage); usable until snow limits access or January 1, whichever comes first.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/bobcat-lake-campground ('The campground is scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day'; 'Reduced services beginning October 15, 2026, no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access or January 1st, whichever is sooner'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground on Bobcat Lake, ~3 mi SE of Marenisco on FR 8500 off M-64, Bessemer RD; run by concessionaire Camp Host, LLC. Swimming beach and day-use area half a mile east. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov Scan and Pay listing: 11 sites (page also says 12 once), $22 (confirmed), first-come only with Scan and Pay (confirmed), 14-day limit, vault toilets + hand pump (confirmed), opens the Friday before Memorial Day with reduced services from Oct 15 to snow/Jan 1 (season added), concessionaire Camp Host, LLC. No current alert or order for FR 8500. Note trimmed of field restatements.
